The '''Ferlani family''' was a major criminal syndicate that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], where it owned the [[Togatto Speedway/Legends|Togatto Speedway]], a [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] area. The family had a rivalry with the [[Largo family]], a criminal family that was based in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Calamar]] on Esseles, and infrequent clashes occurred between the two.<ref name="CCW" />

At some point, a clique of young criminals from among the Ferlani family and Esseles' other criminal families secretly plotted to displace their family leaders and to form an alliance with Esseles' political leaders. The group arranged for police and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] raids to bring down a number of families, and, feeling threatened, [[Luthus Ferlani]]&mdash;the leader of the Ferlani family&mdash;hired a group of agents to investigate the matter. Unknown to the Ferlani, the rebels planned to [[Death/Legends|murder]] the remaining leaders of the Ferlani and the other families during the [[Annual Jatzday Race]] in the Togatto Speedway.<ref name="CCW" />
